newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish forces kill two rebel Kurds in city clash.
newsitem.headline: Turkish forces kill two rebel Kurds in city clash.

text.p: Turkish security officials said on Monday their forces had killed two rebel Kurds in the main southeastern city of Diyarbakir.
Security forces chased the rebels' car around the city and clashed with them for about an hour on Sunday afternoon in a safe house in Diyarbakir's Bagcilar district, police said.
Security forces have in the past clashed with Islamist rebels or guerrillas of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) in Diyarbakir but this was the first this year.
Three people were detained after the killings, police said.
More than 22,000 people have been killed in more than 12 years of fighting between the army and the PKK, which is seeking autonomy or independence in mainly-Kurdish southeast Turkey.
